summary.en: The traditional folded cup and the rolled drinking cone: two ways to drink from one square sheet.
summary.es: El vaso doblado tradicional y el cucurucho enrollado: dos maneras de beber con una sola hoja cuadrada.
summary.fr: Le gobelet plié traditionnel et le cornet roulé : deux façons de boire dans une seule feuille carrée.
summary.pt: O copo dobrado tradicional e o cone enrolado: duas maneiras de beber de uma só folha quadrada.

era: traditional (the folded cup documented from 1934); the rolled cone is a folk technique

note.en: Credited to tradition; every crease is generated by this cartridge.
